CARDS
C01 [person] Dinu - age: Dinu - 30, Colombo cash-transport driver.; details: Quiet, experienced, violent only when cornered.
C02 [person] Aruni - age: Aruni - 27, Mahawewa community nurse.; details: Strong, intelligent and emotionally controlled.
C03 [person] Nimal - age: Nimal - 34, Aruni's elder brother and Dinu's closest friend.; details: It is Nimal.
C04 [person] Mudalali - age: Mudalali - 52, businessman laundering illegal money through village development projects.; details: Mudalali - 52, businessman laundering illegal money through village development projects.
C05 [person] Suren - age: Suren - 38, Mudalali's brutal right-hand man.; gender: Suren - 38, Mudalali's brutal right-hand man.; details: Suren - 38, Mudalali's brutal right-hand man.
C06 [person] Inspector Ruwan - age: Inspector Ruwan - 45, corrupt police officer protecting the money trail.; details: Inspector Ruwan - 45, corrupt police officer protecting the money trail.
L01 [place, region] Colombo - look: CASH VAN - COLOMBO - NIGHT - 1.5 MINUTES Colombo streets shine under rain and sodium lights.
L02 [place, region] Mahawewa village
L03 [place, set in L02] MAHAWEWA CANAL - details: MAHAWEWA CANAL - DAWN - 1 MINUTE Heavy rain.
L04 [place, vehicle in L01] CASH VAN - details: Dinu drives a cash-transfer van.
L05 [place, set in L01] COLOMBO GARAGE - details: Dinu looks at it as rain hits the garage roof.
L06 [place, spot in L03] paddy field - details: Aruni walks beside a paddy field carrying a small medical bag.
L07 [place, spot in L03] canal gate
L08 [place, spot in L02] village bus stop
L09 [place, set] Old Port warehouse
L10 [place, region] industrial area
P01 [thing] medical bag - details: Aruni walks beside a paddy field carrying a small medical bag.
P02 [thing] C-17 - appearance: Inside his fist is a small metal key marked C-17.; details: Nimal places the key in Dinu's hand.
P03 [thing] photo
P04 [thing] red thread
P05 [thing] metal box
P06 [thing] Rs. 300 million
P07 [thing] gun
P08 [thing] recording

DIRECTION RULES
D01 [palette, place L01] Colombo palette - Cold blue, green and sodium orange. Handheld camera, tight frames and crowded backgrounds.
D02 [palette, place L02] Village palette - Warm amber and earthy red. Locked-off frames, natural light and longer silences.
D03 [lens, all scenes] Love scenes - 50mm and 85mm lenses, shallow focus and minimal camera movement.
D04 [lens, all scenes] Action lenses - 24mm for geography, 35mm for movement and 50mm for emotional impact.
D05 [lighting, all scenes] Lighting - Vehicle headlights, sodium lamps, practical bulbs and lightning flashes.
D06 [editing, all scenes] Editing - Fast cuts only on impact. Let important punches and reactions stay on screen.
D07 [sound, all scenes] Sound - Rain, breathing, metal impacts and footsteps first. Music enters only for hero elevation moments.
D08 [slow_motion, all scenes] Slow motion - Use only twice: Nimal's key falling and Dinu removing the gun.
D09 [action, all scenes] The action is mass but not weightless. Every hit has a location, an object or a consequence.
D10 [action, all scenes] Dinu is not an invincible superhero; he wins because he knows vehicles, space and timing.
D11 [action, all scenes] Aruni is an active participant in the climax, and the final victory comes from the recording, the village and their courage - not from violence alone.
D12 [sound, scene 1] She calls Dinu. No answer. A distant bus horn mixes with the rain. Cut to black. TITLE:
D13 [editing, scene 1] She calls Dinu. No answer. A distant bus horn mixes with the rain. Cut to black. TITLE: EKAMA SAKSHIYA.
D14 [sound, scene 2] dashboard is a faded photo of him and Aruni near a village bus stop. Aruni's voice message plays.

CONTINUITY

=== E01-S01 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
42: SCENE 01 - EXT. MAHAWEWA CANAL - DAWN - 1 MINUTE
43: Heavy rain. Aruni walks beside a paddy field carrying a small medical bag. She notices
44: something caught near the canal gate: a body. It is Nimal. She does not scream. She kneels
45: and touches his hand. Inside his fist is a small metal key marked C-17.
46: ARUNI - Dinu... oyata meka ahenne nadda?
47: She calls Dinu. No answer. A distant bus horn mixes with the rain. Cut to black. TITLE:
48: EKAMA SAKSHIYA.

=== E01-S02 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
49: SCENE 02 - INT. CASH VAN - COLOMBO - NIGHT - 1.5 MINUTES
50: Colombo streets shine under rain and sodium lights. Dinu drives a cash-transfer van. On the
51: dashboard is a faded photo of him and Aruni near a village bus stop. Aruni's voice message
52: plays.
53: ARUNI - Nimal thama gedara awilla ne. Oya ada enawa kiyala kiwwa. Mata dan
54: baya hithenawa.
55: Mudalali calls. Route eka maru karapan. Old Port warehouse ekata yanna. Dinu looks at the
56: red thread around his wrist and turns toward the industrial area.

=== E01-S03 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
57: SCENE 03 - FLASHBACK - INT. COLOMBO GARAGE - 2 MINUTES
58: Six hours earlier. Nimal opens a metal box containing photographs, bank documents and the
59: C-17 key.
60: NIMAL - Mudalali ge salli. Rupiyal million 300. Village project walin gaththa salli.
61: DINU - Api meka gaththoth apiuth eyala wage wenawa.
62: NIMAL - Aruniwa aran yanna oyata oni neda? Eya salli nisa nemei, oyage baya nisa
63: oyawa atharinnawa.
64: Nimal places the key in Dinu's hand. Dinu looks at it as rain hits the garage roof.

scenes.title: The canal discovery
scenes.summary: Aruni finds her brother dead beside the sluice, notices the marked key in his grasp and tries unsuccessfully to reach Dinu.
scenes.purpose: Establish the death and the key as a mystery before returning to earlier events.

people.wants: Understand what she has found and reach Dinu.

implied.name: phone
implied.where: In Aruni's hand beside the canal gate when she attempts the call.
implied.why: The attempt to contact Dinu requires a handset; show her initiating the call.

blocks.intent: Establish Aruni's approach through the wet landscape.
blocks.delivery_hint: Hold the wider surroundings before directing attention toward the gate.

events.change: Aruni advances alongside the cultivated land with her bag.

blocks.intent: Resolve an indistinct obstruction into a personal loss.
blocks.delivery_hint: Let recognition register without an abrupt cut away.

events.change: Aruni identifies the body as her brother.

blocks.intent: Express shock through physical restraint rather than an outburst.
blocks.delivery_hint: Stay with her lowered posture and contact with his hand.

events.change: Aruni lowers herself beside him and makes contact without crying out.

blocks.intent: Make the identifying mark on the key readable.
blocks.delivery_hint: Use a close view of the closed hand and exposed object; do not add a removal.

events.change: The key and its identifying mark become apparent in Nimal's grasp.

blocks.speaker: C02
blocks.intent: Appeal to the absent Dinu for a response.
blocks.delivery_hint: Quiet urgency, with the appeal left unanswered; do not establish a connected call.

events.change: Aruni voices an appeal toward Dinu.

blocks.intent: Leave Aruni without contact or reassurance.
blocks.delivery_hint: Show the handset and the small action initiating the attempt, then allow the unanswered pause.

events.change: Aruni attempts to reach Dinu but receives no response.

blocks.intent: Extend the isolation through the surrounding soundscape.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the remote traffic signal beneath the rainfall rather than introducing music.

events.change: A remote horn joins the continuing weather sound.

blocks.intent: End the discovery on an unresolved absence.
blocks.delivery_hint: Make a clean transition to darkness.

events.change: The location image disappears.

blocks.intent: Present the opening title.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the title isolated against the dark field.

events.change: The title appears after the discovery.

scenes.title: The redirected van
scenes.summary: While driving through Colombo, Dinu hears Aruni's worried message about Nimal. Mudalali then orders a different destination, and Dinu steers toward the industrial district.
scenes.purpose: Connect private concern to a potentially dangerous work instruction while preserving the uncertainty around Nimal.

people.wants: Continue his journey while taking in the message and new instructions.
Get reassurance and contact from Dinu about Nimal's absence.
Send Dinu to a different destination.

implied.name: phone
implied.where: In a dashboard mount within Dinu's reach.
implied.why: Message playback and Mudalali's incoming call require a device; establish its display and Dinu starting playback before the voice begins.

blocks.intent: Establish the working journey through the wet city.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep Dinu enclosed by tight framing with city light moving beyond him.

events.change: Dinu proceeds through illuminated, rain-soaked streets.

blocks.intent: Establish the personal history carried inside the working vehicle.
blocks.delivery_hint: Let the dashboard image read without treating its pictured people as present.

events.change: A worn photograph establishes Dinu and Aruni's shared past.

blocks.intent: Introduce the recorded communication from Aruni.
blocks.delivery_hint: Show the mounted device and playback initiation before the recorded voice begins.

events.change: Dinu starts playback on the established device.
Aruni's recorded voice becomes audible inside the vehicle.

blocks.speaker: C02
blocks.intent: Report Nimal's continued absence and seek reassurance from Dinu.
blocks.delivery_hint: Controlled at first, with anxiety becoming more exposed by the end.

events.change: Dinu receives Aruni's concern about her missing brother.

blocks.intent: Interrupt personal concern with a work demand.
blocks.delivery_hint: Use the already established handset to identify and accept the incoming call before its voice is heard.

events.change: An incoming call from Mudalali takes over the device.

blocks.speaker: C04
blocks.intent: Replace Dinu's current route with an instruction to go to L09.
blocks.delivery_hint: Brief and authoritative, without added explanation.

events.change: Dinu is ordered to head for a different destination.

blocks.intent: Link Dinu's private reaction to his change of course without explaining the wrist thread.
blocks.delivery_hint: Hold the glance briefly, then show the directional change without heightened action cutting.

events.change: Dinu studies the thread he wears and redirects the vehicle toward L10.

scenes.title: The garage handover
scenes.summary: Earlier, Nimal exposes evidence of diverted project money. Dinu objects to taking it, but Nimal pressures him through his relationship with Aruni and gives him the key.
scenes.purpose: Reveal the moral conflict behind Dinu's involvement and establish the key's earlier possession without explaining its later return.

people.wants: Persuade Dinu to act on the evidence and accept the key.
Avoid becoming like the people responsible for the stolen money.

blocks.intent: Locate the exchange before the nighttime journey.
blocks.delivery_hint: Make the temporal shift clear without adding a new event.

events.change: The narrative moves back six hours.

blocks.intent: Expose the collected evidence and the key together.
blocks.delivery_hint: Show the container opening and allow its contents to be legible.

events.change: Nimal opens the container, exposing images, financial papers and the marked key.

blocks.speaker: C03
blocks.intent: Identify the money's owner, scale and connection to village projects.
blocks.delivery_hint: Direct and concrete, treating the evidence as something Dinu must confront.

events.change: Nimal attributes the diverted funds to Mudalali.

blocks.speaker: C01
blocks.intent: Reject taking the money on moral grounds.
blocks.delivery_hint: Quiet firmness rather than an aggressive challenge.

events.change: Dinu challenges the proposed act as morally compromising.

blocks.speaker: C03
blocks.intent: Use Dinu's hopes about Aruni to overcome his resistance.
blocks.delivery_hint: Personal and pressing; keep the claims about Aruni clearly Nimal's assertions.

events.change: Nimal shifts the argument from money to Dinu's fear and relationship.

blocks.intent: Make the transfer of responsibility tangible.
blocks.delivery_hint: Show the hand-to-hand transfer at ordinary speed, without implying a fall.

events.change: The key passes from Nimal into Dinu's hand.

blocks.intent: Leave Dinu's response unresolved after the handover.
blocks.delivery_hint: Hold his attention on the object while roof rainfall carries the pause.

events.change: Dinu studies the key without stating a decision.
Rainfall remains audible against the building overhead.
